notes.title: Roadmap to Bootstrap Island’s Full Release Revealed!
notes.content:
[h1][b]The full vision of our VR survival game![/b][/h1]
[previewyoutube=JObtRESe7tY;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Released Major Updates (1-2-3)[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42159392/4940e45d68b46ad23f5f0cc4c443fd32dd2a82cb.png[/img]
The first three major updates have laid a strong foundation - introducing the [b]inventory[/b] and [b]building systems[/b], allowing players to craft shelter and manage scarce resources. The terrifying [b]Jungle Overlord[/b] boss fight added a major combat challenge, while the [b]dynamic weather system[/b] brought unpredictability to every step.

[h1]Upcoming Major Updates[/h1]
[h2]Major Update 4: Riverlands (Summer 2025)[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42159392/0fd83d4d6037f8d15eb7e2592a26ee5f8324bb7b.png[/img]
This summer, the island expands. [b]Major Update 4: Riverlands[/b] will introduce a vast new region shaped by rivers. But beware- these waters are dangerous. Expect new threats like [b]gharial attacks[/b], [b]electric eels[/b], and strong [b]river currents[/b] that demand caution and new strategies.

You'll also find [b]new resources[/b] like a tropical fruit, and wield the [b]musket sling[/b]- a new tool for survival.

[h2]Major Update 5: Visions[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42159392/5f9226d52792fec663826285e0f6ca28fd165c1a.png[/img]
Next up, [b]Major Update 5: Visions[/b] explores the psychological effects of survival. After a violent storm, you'll face [b]sickness-induced hallucinations[/b] and [b]flashback visions[/b]. Survival will no longer be just physical - it becomes mental.

Manage your condition with new [b]medicinals[/b], but tread carefully: [b]quicksand[/b] adds a new environmental hazard. This update also introduces a [b]tutorial[/b] to help newcomers adapt.

[h1]The Full Release[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42159392/daf4c79c3ad89b3cd553b1a5428a35398059d985.png[/img]
All roads lead to the [b]full release[/b], where the island’s deepest mysteries will come to light.

The arrival of [b]tribal inhabitants[/b] - including a [b]Shaman[/b] - will unlock rich [b]social dynamics[/b] and [b]narrative depth[/b]. Communication won’t rely on words. Players will use [b]body language[/b] to build trust... or trigger aggression.

New [b]tribal items[/b] and [b]artifacts[/b] will deepen survival, story, and culture in a way that makes every encounter meaningful.

Full release planned for Q1 2026

[p][i]Wishlist, follow, and stay updated as the island continues to evolve.[/i][/p]

notes.title: Major Update 3 - Weather! Live Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42159392/f21ca3843a19f82863b8e806cf5c61c9b36e8c56.gif[/img][h2]Dear Survivors,[/h2]

[h3][b]Major Update #3 - The Weather is Here!⛈️ [/b][/h3] 

The island has changed forever! [b]Weather now plays a crucial role in survival[/b], dynamically shaping the world and affecting every aspect of gameplay. The new weather system doesn’t just add realism - it forces to think ahead, adapt, and truly engage with the environment. Every storm, every gust of wind, and every drop of rain can impact your survival. 

[h3][b]Survival Just Got Tougher:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Fire-making and firearms[/b] are now impacted by wet conditions. Stay dry or risk losing essential tools.
[*] [b]Water collection[/b] is now easier, making rainfall a valuable resource.
[*] [b]Rain and wind[/b] affect visibility, movement, and planning. Watch the sky to anticipate the coming weather!
[*] [b]Lightning[/b] is both a beauty and a threat - it can set objects ablaze and even injure you.
[/list]
[h3][b]New Wildlife & Survival Features:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]The Wild Storm[/b] – A brutal survival event that will test your limits.
[*] [b]Warthogs[/b] – Aggressive and territorial, these creatures attack without warning. A dangerous but rewarding food source! 
[*] [b]Critters[/b] – Small lizards and frogs can now be caught by hand, with weapons, or even by throwing rocks. Eat them raw or cook them for a quick meal. 
[*] [b]Roof Construction[/b] – A new shelter-building option with [b]palm leaves[/b] to protect against rain and wind, ensuring better survival conditions. 
[/list]
[h3][b]More Enhancements:[/b][/h3]
[list] 
[*] [b]Extended the length of a day[/b] and [b]reduced the number of survival days[/b] required to unlock items.
[*] [b]14 new original music tracks[/b], [b]tons of new sound effects[/b], and [b]new voiceover lines[/b] to heighten immersion. 
[*] [b]Further optimized performance[/b], including DLSS 3.8 support for a smoother experience. 
[/list]

🙏 [b]One more thing[/b] - if you enjoy the game and appreciate our work, please consider leaving a review on Steam! Your feedback helps us continue improving the game. Thank you for your support! 🙏

🤓 [b]Please note:[/b] When continuing the game with an existing save, new animals and items do not spawn, as they weren’t part of the original seed when your game was generated. We also teleported you back to the starting beach, as we made some changes to the map and we do not want you to get stuck in the rocks. 
However, all new systems and content should function as intended. Happy surviving! 🌴

[h2]NB! We're currently working on a bug that may affect your unlocks in the game - hotfix coming soon![/h2]

We welcome you on our [url=https://discord.gg/q8m3CRVVmJ]Discord[/url]! Come and tell us about your survival adventure! 🌴🔥

notes.title: Patch 0.2.1 Day Count Feature and Various Improvements!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42159392/e8fb85ab022f98c1e57651a767714a5587429062.png[/img]

[h2]Dear Survivors,[/h2]

[h3][b]Patch 0.2.1 - Day Count Feature and Various Improvements is Now Live! [/b][/h3]

This update introduces various bug fixes and some Quality of Life improvements to Bootstrap Island. In addition to adding a Day Count and Grab Toggle to the game, most of the teething issues with Satchel and Book of Building features should now be fixed. Most of the team is now working on some huge new things for the next Major Update but this is still months away from going live, so be patient!

Your feedback helps us shape the game, so please let us know what you think!

[h3][b]Patch 0.2.1 Notes:[/b][/h3]

[b]1. New gameplay feature - Day Count. [/b] When you open the in-game menu, you can see the current day count.

[b]2. New gameplay setting - Grab Toggle. [/b] If you switch to this mode, you don’t have to continuosly press the grab button to hold items.

[b]3. Additional improvements:[/b]
* Wooden crates now burn when exposed to fire.
* Fixed a lagspike when placing items into Satchel.
* Improved some item placements in Satchel. Note that when you continue a pre-update game after updating, some objects in Satchel might have odd locations or rotations. Taking them out and putting them back in should fix the issue.
* Improved cordage tying when near fire.
* Cordage now properly gets wet and burns in fire.
* Cordage is now harder to find in the world.
* Satchel is now waterproof.
* Destroying a building using the book now returns all cordage.
* Destroying a building using force returns some cordage.
* Pistol now retains its cocked state when holstering and deholstering
* Fixed floatiness of the pistol, it now feels much more responsive.
* Fixed a bug where a deholstered pistol would not survive save/load.
* Reenabled seagull sounds and seagulls flying away during the night.
* Adjusted the material of building outlines and book line color.
* Improved building interactions and fixed related bugs.
* You can no longer place building outlines into rocks and other unreachable locations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42159392/a27cbd4e746914ba7d9f25c3ccdbe674542ecc21.jpg[/img]

[h2]Dear Survivors,[/h2]

[h3][b]Major Update #1 - Building and Inventory is Now Live! [/b][/h3]

We are thrilled to announce the release of our [b]First Major Update[/b] since we launched the game into Early Access three months ago. This update introduces two highly anticipated features: an extensive building system and enhanced inventory management. These additions promise to elevate the survival experience and provide players with even more ways to explore and thrive on the ruthless island.

Your feedback helps us shape the game, so please let us know what you think!

[previewyoutube=4GTCUu7M-Qs;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]Major Update #1 (Patch 0.2.0) Notes:[/b][/h3]

[b]1. New unlockable item - Satchel. [/b]Note that the item has to be unlocked first and then found in chests. You can carry two satchels (one on your left shoulder, one on your right shoulder) and switch them out.

[b]2. New unlockable item - Book of Building.[/b] Note that the item has to be unlocked first and then found in chests. You can use it to place plans for buildable structures and to destroy plans/structures.

[b][b]3. Two recipes in the Book of Building [/b]- a wall and a gate. [/b]You can use both natural and shipwreck wood to build, given that it’s at proper length.

[b]4, New usable plant - cordage root.[/b] Likes to grow on enbankments. Very useful for building but not indestructible. 

[b]5. Revamped wood items to better accomodate building. [/b]Both natural and shipwreck wood pieces now fall into three categorys: longer pieces of wood, shorter pieces of wood, wood unfit for building. 

[b]6. Greatly improved item selection mechanic [/b] - makes it easier to pick up objects if there are several objects together.

[b]7. New gameplay setting - grab selection. [/b]Item which is selected for grabbing is highlighted and displays a white “seal” icon. This option is on by default but can be turned off in settings. Note that grab selection is always enabled when taking items from Satchel.

[b]8. Some shipwreck debris has washed ashore. [/b]You can use it to make your new home more cozy. 

[b]9. Additional improvements:[/b]
* Climbable wall next to the liana in ravine now looks nicer. 
* Improved foliage in a number of places.
* Improved geometry in a number of places.
* Improved the interiors of caves.
* Fixed a large number of bugs.
* Fixed and improved some sounds.
* More music added to the game for exploration and nights. 
* Health, thirst and hunger bar animate when a value changes.
* Fixed issues with animal aggressions, they now attack if their numbers are sufficient. 

[b]Known issues:[/b]
* Satchel and building still need some polish and bugfixing. Feedback and bug reporting is very welcome, as it helps us identifying issues.
* Seagulls are strangely quiet.
* There appears to be some issues with liquid pouring. We are looking into it.

We would love to see what you can build! Let us know what you think on our [url=https://discord.gg/2VQxf7H8]Discord[/url]!

We are excited to announce that Bootstrap Island`s Gameplay Reveal will take place on February 20, at 5pm PST!

The developers will present new features, areas, resources and creatures of the Early Access game. Spoiler alert! :)  

[h3]Some of the key features of the game:[/h3]

[b]1. A ruthless roguelike experience with short intense sessions[/b]. 
No hand-holding, no tutorials, survive as best you can. Different strategies work, find out what tactics is best for you;

[b]2. Progression system[/b]. 
Surviving longer unlocks new resources and improves further chances;

[b]3. Randomized resources and consequence-based outcomes to your decisions[/b]. 
Every session is different, you never know what you will find and where;

[b]4. Dynamic open world game featuring realistic, simulated physics and systems-based gameplay[/b].
Experiment with diverse solutions as in the real world (day and night, fire, liquid, etc., all with a direct impact on gameplay);

[b]5. A captivating narrative, set in a 17th century storybook atmosphere[/b]. 
The story changes according to the player`s progress and decisions. Every player will have unique experience and story;

[b]6. Its only PC VR – to maximize the immersive experience in VR[/b]. 
Not a port of a console or a standalone game.

Bootstrap Island`s Gameplay Reveal will be showcased on [url=https://www.youtube.com/@bootstrapisland6598]Bootstrap Island Youtube[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42159392/8575ef44e73a22d02599fd935c840a0431cb0b69.jpg[/img]
[h1]Survival Journal on [url=https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLQiYDuz7fGtIlzaMOG43WI5HRpKVKgBgy]Bootstrap Island YouTube[/url][/h1]

Elevate your expertise with a variety of strategies tailored for thriving on a tropical island adventure! 
New entries added every week to [url=https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLQiYDuz7fGtIlzaMOG43WI5HRpKVKgBgy]Bootstrap Island Survival Journal Playlist[/url].

[h3][url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yHksmBm_fL0&ab_channel=BootstrapIsland]Delicious Protein: Satisfaction of the hunt[/url][/h3]
[i]"Hunting for animals here can be challenging, but the satisfaction of a successful hunt is unparalleled. Today, I tried something new - I tasted bat meat for the first time. The flavor was surprisingly rich and gamey, satisfying a longing I didn't know I had."[/i]

[previewyoutube=yHksmBm_fL0;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][url=https://www.youtube.com/shorts/0sR0X3FwqSE]Carryable Firepower: Swift reloading makes me the real danger...[/url][/h3]
[i]"Until recently I used a coconut to haul around bullets and powder. Finding a holster for my gun and a box for bullets speeds up the loading dramatically. For the first time in a while I feel powerful."[/i]

[previewyoutube=0sR0X3FwqSE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][url=https://www.youtube.com/shorts/WObqk6Qrzsc]Hungry for Crab: Exquisitely tasty...when grilled to perfection...[/url][/h3]
[i]"The crabs are hard to seize, but I have found various ways for catching them - sharp sticks, guns, rocks. Alas, the crabs are worthless without cooking and I must also take care not to burn them. Nothing comes easy on this island."[/i]

[previewyoutube=WObqk6Qrzsc;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][url=https://www.youtube.com/shorts/4H-zhHGZwoM]Crack the Coconut: hit, smash & shoot! [/url][/h3]
[i]"I've gotten good at opening coconuts. At first, I used a stone, but it took a while. It's quicker to seize the coconut with both hands and smack it against rocks. But the fastest way is to throw the nuts swiftly at the rocks, which also spares my hands a couple of bruises. I could also shoot the coconut with a pistol, but dare not squander a bullet on that."[/i]

[previewyoutube=4H-zhHGZwoM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][url=https://www.youtube.com/shorts/P_oEGMt6QuQ]A Defensive Circle of Fire: Would flames keep the beasts at bay?[/url][/h3]
[i]"By now I know that the beasts hold fear for fire. I wondered whether a grand circle of flames around me would keep the beasts at bay. But there is always a chance that something will attack from the sky... what ought I do then?"[/i]

[previewyoutube=P_oEGMt6QuQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kgg8uw2uS0I]Clinging to Life: Either I hold on or meet my demise...[/url][/h3]
[i]"So I've been pondering...the hounds prove to be terrible at scaling rocks and even more so with ropes or vines. What if I spent the whole night on a rope grasping a flame in the other hand? A torch ought to endure through the night. I pray my arms do likewise."[/i]

[previewyoutube=kgg8uw2uS0I;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9e1dlSyO6Ws]Mastery in Climbing: I have found power in heights[/url][/h3]
[i]"Isolated on this island, I've become adept in navigating its jungle. I've uncovered shortcuts and learned to climb with finesse. The dense foliage and elevated terrains now yield to my practised moves. I have found power in heights."[/i]

[previewyoutube=9e1dlSyO6Ws;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]New journal entries and other survival videos every week on [url=https://www.youtube.com/@bootstrapisland6598]Bootstrap Island YouTube[/url][/h2]

notes.title: Bootstrap Island @ Steam VR Fest
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42159392/fe8db0e2d83b2d73bcf82899cc91902724ef451a.jpg[/img]

VR players will get a chance to test out the latest version of Bootstrap Island this week during Steam VR Fest (December 4-11th), finding themselves shipwrecked on a mysterious tropical island in the 17th century. They will need to quickly learn to adapt and survive by exploring for food and drink, collecting materials to make fire; and surviving the dark night from being attacked by ferocious beasts. 

Focused entirely on PCVR headsets, like Valve Index and Meta (Oculus) Quest PC-link devices; Bootstrap Island offers a realistic survival adventure in an immersive, yet comfortable VR experience designed with minimal menus and natural feeling controls. 

Some of the game’s features PCVR players can look forward to exploring are: 
[list]
[*][b]In-depth systems-based gameplay[/b] like tearing open coconuts for nourishment and tinder
[*][b]Realistic and detailed interactions[/b] such as striking together flints to create sparks for a fire
[*][b]A dynamic day and night cycle[/b] on the island
[*][b]Finding randomized resources[/b] inside locked treasure chests
[*]The grande finale of witnessing an [b]active volcano erupt[/b] 🌋
[/list]
The Bootstrap Island development team will also make an appearance during Steam VR Fest for 2 livestreams scheduled for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1942110/view/3901868807307209101]Wednesday Dec 7th on Youtube[/url], and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1942110/view/3720593210591497796?l=english] Thursday Dec 8th on Twitch[/url]. The developers will be discussing the origins and future development of Bootstrap Island, answering players' questions, as well as sharing a few tropical survival tips.

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
The Bootstrap Island demo has been updated with some most requested features. The day is now significantly longer! We cleaned the flintlock pistol and reworked the hop-up system to be more useful.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42159392/618f3effb871ba9d5348997fc3885b7f408bc38b.gif[/img]

Hello, survivors! We have some news:

🌴 The endless mode of the Bootstrap Island demo has been updated with some most requested features. To access the endless mode, please right click the game in your Steam library, choose Properties, choose Betas, enter the code [b[morningcomes[/b] and choose “endless mode”. We would love to hear your feedback!

☀️ The day is now significantly longer! This is the most requested change and we implemented it to the endless mode, so give it a shot and let us know what you think.

🔫 We cleaned the flintlock pistol, turned out there was some sand and seawater in there. It's now much easier to use and more reliable. The current world record of beasts killed per night is 4, can you beat it?
🫳 Also significant, we reworked the hop-up system to be more useful. The way it works now is that you hold your palm facing the thing on the ground and then hop the item up to your hand. It might feel strange at first but it's noticeably slicker than before. Again, feedback is welcome!

🔥 There is no embargo on the endless version, you can feel free to make videos or share on social media. Please also note that currently the playtest key is not necessary to play the regular demo on Steam, as you can just download the demo from the Steam page but this might change in the future.


[url=https://discord.gg/gMT5zyUDmz][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42159392/53151dc89ded1509920a6d817bfdc3c3763451c4.png[/img][/url]

notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1942110/Bootstrap_Island/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42159392/98b724ceb10ea8fcae1bb6e75b3af21fb78a45cd.png[/img][/url]

Steam VR players looking for a challenging and innovative demo during Steam Next Fest (October 9-16) will have the opportunity to get a first look at Bootstrap Island, a Robinson Crusoe-style virtual reality survival game set in the 17th century.

[previewyoutube=zA_YQbU0W-o;full][/previewyoutube]

VR gamers who download the demo will awake to find themselves shipwrecked on a mysterious tropical island, where they must quickly learn to adapt and survive by exploring for food and drink, collecting materials to make fire; and surviving the dark night from being eaten alive by ferocious beasts.

[previewyoutube=gOyJY_-7rAQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Some of the game’s features PCVR players can look forward to exploring are: 
[list]
[*][b]in-depth systems-based gameplay [/b]like tearing open coconuts for nourishment and tinder
[*][b]Realistic and detailed interactions[/b] such as striking together flints to create sparks for a fire
[*][b]Dynamic day and night cycle[/b] on the island
[*][b]Finding randomized resources[/b] inside locked treasure chests
[*]Witnessing an [b]active volcano erupt[/b]!
[/list]

[previewyoutube=FV4mBF1PAQw;full][/previewyoutube]

During the week of Steam Next Fest, a variety of top VR talent including Soul Fox Gaming, Atom Bomb Body, IndieVR, Misery VR, ChickenMeChanga, c0ld vengeance and MrsAllHerShots will all lend their expertise to show off the many facets and pitfalls this roguelike game has to offer. The choices these VR gamers make will be critical to their chances of survival, with every decision perhaps resulting in life or death consequences.
